assumptions: BLIND RECOUNT (swe lane, swap check A) — written before reading any swe2 tally.

CLI `haarpsi-y` -> haarpsi_luma8 (lib.rs:288-313): plane_from_rgb8 subsample=TRUE — fused 2x box-mean in f64 + Y dot (kernel.rs:225-259) -> work at W2=ceil(W/2) x H2=ceil(H/2) on PAD=8 zero-framed planes.
Ingress per out el: 4 px x 3 ch f64 add-mean (12 add + 3 mul... folded) + Y dot 3 mul + 2 add + cvt, -> ~20 ops per half-res el.

Haar filters (kernel.rs:750-824): 2 orientations x 3 scales (hk=1,2,4) x 2 images, all on the W2xH2 padded plane. o=0 vertical: CS column box-sums hk taps over h+hk rows (~hk add+ld per el) then coeff = 2^-k sum of 2hk CS row diffs (2hk add+2ld+mul). o=1 horizontal: RS row box hk + rowdiff 2hk. Per (o,k,img) ~ 3hk adds + 3hk loads + 1 mul + 2 st per el.
Fold per orientation: k=0 sim=(2|a||b|+C)/(|a|^2+|b|^2+C) (~7 flops+div), k=1 simavg (avg of sims, +1 add+mul), k=2 wmax=max(|a|,|b|) weight map (2 abs + cmp). haarpsi-y: no I/Q third map (iq=None).

Pooling (kernel.rs:864-908,571-613): per map per el logistic_block = full expf-class body (~14 flops: range-reduce + poly + div) * w + 2 f64 accumulates; 2 maps; then m=s_t/s_w, logit log + square once.
Zero pad frame + scratch planes counted as implementation where materialized (cs/rs/ca/cb/ls/wm planes are scratch reuse).

stages.name: RGB8 -> f64 2x2 mean + Y dot -> f32 half-res padded
stages.notes: 4-px box mean per channel (f64) then Y dot; pad frame is scratch.

stages.name: box-sum rows/cols per (o,k): hk taps
stages.notes: Sum over k=0..2 of hk={1,2,4}: 7 add+7 ld+~2.3 st per el per (o,img). CS extra rows h+hk folded (~+1% at 4K).

stages.name: 2^-k strip/row diffs of 2hk taps -> coeff planes
stages.notes: Per (o,k): 2hk diffs+sum; summed over k: 14 add + 3 mul + ~2 ld per el per (o,img).

stages.name: sim(k=0), simavg(k=1), wmax(k=2) per orientation
stages.notes: Per orientation: sim ~7 flops+div + simavg + wmax (2abs+cmp) -> ls[o], wm[o].

stages.name: weighted logistic pool over 2 maps
stages.notes: logistic_block ~14 flops (expf body: mul+ceil+2polyfma+div+scale) + w*l + 2 f64 acc. Final logit log+square once.
